name: bws-skillgate
description: Skill gating: on a conversation's first prompt a small model picks the skills that fit it and the skill listing the model reads is cut to those (plus any /name the prompt names); later prompts only add skills, so the prompt cache holds. /skillgate [off|on|status|explain].

mode.title: Skill gate
mode.description: off (default): the model sees the full skill listing. on: a small model picks the skills that fit the prompt and the listing is cut to those. Change it for a session with /skillgate.

topK.title: Skills kept
topK.description: At most this many skills the classifier picks (1 to 20), plus any the prompt names with /name.

model.title: Classifier model
model.description: Model alias or id that picks the skills (haiku, sonnet, opus, or a full id).
